method: Read all 264 file-first transport, custody, handoff, package, disclosure and reservation propositions, all 43 full context profiles and the one exact caption occurrence set. Every full payload is compared with immutable predecessor evidence. All 1,198 ordered old occurrence bindings are reconstructed from their frozen original binding-array pointer and content-addressed transport references, and verified against exact source bytes. Eight predecessor indentation representation qualifications are explicitly preserved without normalization. Current semantic domains are distinguished from byte custody, fixed metadata and authority constraints. No implementation, tests or proof results were opened.

decisions.PRESERVED_PROMPT_AND_LAUNCHER: The exact prompt byte encoding, path, filename, media type, final newline, body digest, no-self-hash rule, preview and sole controlling instruction artifact remain. The fixed launcher is bootstrap only. A–F2 alter applicable substantive content, not these byte/authority constraints or the optional nonauthoritative clipboard convenience.
decisions.PRESERVED_RAW_TRANSPORT: The three ordered durable phases, bounded selection/staging, actual byte hashes/readback, exact raw capture, proposal-to-raw pointer, validation history, exact staged-byte promotion and truthful retry/failure handling remain. C1 expressly excludes response transport from intake mapping; D primitive parsing is not this closed response transport. Preserved byte promotion is no acceptance of old complete semantics; the actual disposition/precondition/state/receipt obligations are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_SLOTS: The exact application-owned slot and metadata/role bindings, named operator selection, no filename/order shortcut, duplicate/missing/cross-package/extra/mismatch rejection and actual-byte verification remain. C1 does not replace attachment admission with intake member ordering. F2 supplies no new slot authority or observed external possession.
decisions.PRESERVED_CUSTODY_AND_REUSE: Actual stored-byte SHA-256 is byte identity; actor names/digests remain claims. Browser custody never establishes that an external actor or tool has the bytes, as F2 explicitly confirms. Reuse retained exact files, identify unavoidable external transfer, and do not require repeated semantic resupply or pasted file bodies. Current minimal handoff membership is separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_DISCLOSURE: The six disclosure classes, CREDENTIAL_SECRET prohibition, restricted/unknown recipient suitability and human authorization, existing scans and prohibited-member exclusion, original-preserving redaction and no clean-scan proof remain. Intake metadata and route names grant no disclosure permission. Actual derived allowlist and metadata inventory are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_HANDOFF_SHAPE: The shared engine-selected object and exact individually stated handoff/file/withheld/return fields, labels, application-owned role/slot IDs, stored-byte exports and truthful unavailable/no-auto-transfer disclosures remain. These structural/authority/label atoms do not claim unchanged current content or actual complete execution inputs, which are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_PACKAGE_SHAPE: The logical container and manifest identities, createExecutionPackage parameter interface, canonical artifact retrieval, metadata fields, prompt/manifest exports, blind-alias withholding and minimum-disclosure constraints remain. Neither C1 intake mapping nor F2 evidence basis changes deterministic outbound archive transport or this fixed interface. Actual required member, return contract, scope and validity domains are separately changed. Existing indentation representation is preserved exactly where qualified.
decisions.PRESERVED_RESERVATION: The atomic one-transaction identity allocation and committed reservationRevision, non-scope-changing metadata events, exact closed state set, still-current orphan resume and exact-idempotent retry before stale rejection remain. F1 retains reservation/retry/replacement controls. This does not declare an old package current after A–F2 dependency changes; different stale payloads still reject.
decisions.EXACT_ATTACHMENT_ACCEPTANCE_CONTEXT: The base1568 caption governs precisely original1569–1573 and their five exact child identities: artifact relationship, authorized filename, media contract, actual size and actual SHA-256. It neither absorbs other upstream references nor claims semantic acceptance of amended response contents. Its original governed occurrence set remains exact.
decisions.CURRENT_RESPONSE_DISPOSITION_AND_ACCEPTA: Actual proposal/fail-closed disposition, every acceptance precondition, complete canonical change, derived state/invalidation and completed receipt/extraction manifest now consume applicable A–F2 admitted input/schema/availability/native/variance/conditional-route dependencies. Three-phase durability and exact bytes remain. Historical inherited-reference qualifiers remain pending explicit linkage; this is no implementation acceptance.
decisions.EXACT_MINIMAL_CURRENT_HANDOFF: Actual required current candidate/product/artifact/evidence members now include applicable C/C1 retained occurrences, A human context, B/E reviewed test dependencies and F1/F2 exact compatible input/history/target bindings. Minimality cannot omit required data or expose the whole project, blind aliases or future-stage material. Exact bytes, disclosure and scope remain; no echo establishes recipient custody.
decisions.CURRENT_DISCLOSURE_ALLOWLIST_AND_METADAT: The actual derived allowlist and supported metadata inventory must include applicable C/C1 retained child/member/name/extra/comment occurrences and F1 selected execution inputs. They retain the original disclosure and secret constraints. Metadata is data, not permission or instructions; no route label or intake unit authorizes transfer.
decisions.CURRENT_EXECUTION_AND_CONTEXT_HANDOFF: Deriving the actual handoff from current execution plan and exact context applies B reviewed target availability, D admitted native semantics, E current variance/test identity and F1/F2 compatible history/target/phase/input basis. The engine retains sole selection authority, fixed executor and withholding rules; missing applicable facts cannot yield an executable handoff.
decisions.CURRENT_EXPECTED_RESULT_AND_EVIDENCE: The current expected result, evidence, return contract and response schema require applicable A closed human requests, B proof reference, D admitted definitions/results, E variance and F1/F2 exact route/current input obligations. The fixed response.json/attachment transport remains. A schema label or actor echo cannot substitute for current closed contents, actual execution or stronger independence/evidence.
decisions.STAGE22_REQUIRED_ARTIFACT_DOMAIN: The exact Stage22 shared-artifact requirement remains, while its effective required-input domain now depends on B accepted current target availability and D precise native inputs. Required product bytes must be included consistently with Stages23–25; no future unavailable target or unsupported definition becomes ready. Applicable historical XML linkage remains explicit.
decisions.CURRENT_MANIFEST_SCOPE_AND_VALIDITY: Actual current scope and validity bind A lifecycle, B accepted availability, D affected semantic identities, E normalized variance/test snapshot and F1/F2 compatible current execution history/input. Fixed manifest fields, hashing, atomic reservation and target-slot rules remain. An old scope or echoed package cannot bypass a stronger current prerequisite.

qualifier: The separately accepted technical-reference interpretation resolves policy meaning in its exact attributed scope. These historical reference qualifiers are preserved pending explicit per-entry effective-dependency and typed-governor linkage review; they are not a claim that the normative input remains missing or an automatic scope-wide identity change.
